sql: SELECT MAX(l.Date) AS lab_completed_date, (CAST(substr(p.`First Date`,1,4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(p.Birthday,1,4) AS INTEGER)) AS age_at_arrival FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND p.Birthday = (SELECT MIN(Birthday) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS')
